name: scan-planner-reproduction
title: Integrate SCAN-Planner Foxy with Lite3 Physics Simulation
description: Port the pinned SCAN ROS 2 planner core to Foxy and validate a versioned TCP closed loop against a pinned Lite3 Isaac policy simulation on the 5070 Ti.
creator: sun
notes: V3 uses the pinned sensor-rig URDF with V12 model_149999 plus live MID-360-like and D435i-like simulated sensors. Asset, locomotion A/B, dual-sensor, two-dry-run, frozen closed-loop, sync, and local re-evaluation gates passed 71/71. Human review remains required; V2 is baseline-only. V4 preview02 passed its bounded automated forest-locomotion gates, but on 2026-08-14 Dr Sun requested faster motion and obstacle avoidance, so V4 is preserved as a change-requested baseline rather than accepted. V5 produced two passing dry runs and one frozen automated candidate at 0.50 m/s, but Dr Sun requested V6 at 1.0 m/s, correction of the apparent rock/proxy or rock/terrain interpenetration, and simultaneous planned-versus-actual trajectory display. V5 remains immutable change-requested evidence. V6 candidate02 passed the frozen 100/100 gate with 1.0 m/s limits, real-mesh rock seating, and a hashed planned-versus-actual trajectory overlay. All 217 remote-produced files have exact local SHA-256 parity and all 14 videos fully decode. AC34 and task completion remain pending Dr Sun's human review; no training or real-robot work was authorized.
